title: The web trail
intro: Websites leak more than their owners think. Follow five small web puzzles from a strange address to a forged token.
outro: You read what the address, the robots file, the page source, a cookie and a token gave away. Servers must never trust what the browser sends.
w1.story: A link full of percent signs. Decode it to see where it really goes.
w2.story: A robots.txt file lists what the site does not want searched. That is where to look.
w3.story: Developers leave notes in the page source. Read it.
w4.story: A cookie that just says who you are. Could you say something else?
w5.story: A token in three parts. Read each one.
